initial_parent_inventory.null_coverage_meaning: No fixed value or experimental best-fit selected; an optimizer or explicit scan supplies each candidate.
initial_parent_inventory.coverage_units: monolayer equivalents under the separately supplied definition

monolayer_definition.area_basis: must define molecules per geometric material-face square metre, or supply an explicit consistent microscopic-area conversion

spatial_profile.initial_scenario: one common scalar N_ML on each retained material face
spatial_profile.normalization: literal multiplier; do not normalize away true side/broad area differences

existing_binding_api.allocation: One H2O parent pool, or normalized bound-state fractions partitioning this same parent inventory

scan_and_regression.domain_rule: Candidates must remain within supplied reservoir max_coverage_m2, kinetic validity and numerical domain; no arbitrary physical upper bound is invented.
scan_and_regression.forward_rule: Bind each candidate to actual H2O source coverage before depletion, then recompute or explicitly validate reuse of transport, full CR and optical/detector projection.
scan_and_regression.forbidden_substitution: Do not fit a multiplier on the historical independent H/H2/H2O/OH densities or on their already-solved spectra.
scan_and_regression.kinetic_reference_coverage: Keep supplied reservoir reference_coverage_m2 fixed across the coverage scan; it is not the monolayer definition or a second inventory knob.
scan_and_regression.optical_scale_nuisance: If absolute optical/detector throughput is unresolved, its scale can be multiplicatively confounded with coverage in a linear forward regime. Constrain it independently or report the degeneracy, not a unique absolute monolayer count.
scan_and_regression.monolayer_definition_nuisance: If sigma_ML remains undefined, a qualified inventory fit constrains initial_h2o_monolayers*sigma_ML rather than the monolayer count alone.

initial_nonwater_source_inventory.units: particles assigned independently to the desorbing surface source
initial_nonwater_source_inventory.policy: A nonzero independent contaminant pool requires its own amount, chemical/state definition and provenance; it is not another copy of the water inventory.

desorption_transaction.required_rates: A stated H2O surface-release law with supported attempt/barrier/coverage-dependence parameters and temperature/coverage domain; do not inherit illustrative four-pool rates as sourced physical data.
desorption_transaction.source_physical_state_mapping: Resolve desorbed H2O electronic/rovibrational populations; fractions partition the one parent event and must sum to one.
desorption_transaction.energy_and_momentum: Read back actual sampled translation, internal state energy, removal debit, outward placement and support momentum with one owning reservoir.
desorption_transaction.surface_fragment_desorption: Not enabled; introducing direct surface fragments requires an explicit parent-conserving surface reaction and sourced state/energy branching.

gas_chemistry.fragment_source: Accepted time-dependent chemical and dissociative-excitation reactions, not prescribed fixed fragment yields
gas_chemistry.nuclei_budget: In a closed control, H nuclei=2*N_H2O_initial and O nuclei=N_H2O_initial across adsorbed parents, all gas states/products and accounted boundary exits; add any independent contaminants explicitly.
gas_chemistry.charge_budget: Retain signed ion/electron charge and boundary/current exchange; charge balance is not inferred from the neutral map alone.

electron_inputs.numerical_policy: Require finite nonnegative per-cell electron density histories and a normalized EEDF on declared support, or a qualified bounded thermal-rate closure; missing inputs are not filled by zero or wall temperature.

conditional_linear_regime: Prescribed wall temperature and a coverage-independent first-order release law
Prescribed density-independent transport and a fixed source-state distribution
Prescribed electron density/EEDF unaffected by the added neutral inventory
A linear state-population operator without neutral-density-dependent quenching or nonlinear chemical losses
Optically thin emission, fixed collection geometry and unsaturated linear detector response
nonlinear_effects_requiring_recomputatio: Coverage-dependent desorption barriers or competing surface populations
Desorption energy feedback on wall temperature
Neutral-neutral chemistry, quenching or density-dependent transport
Self-consistent electron/ionization, field or energy feedback
Opacity, radiative trapping, self-absorption or detector saturation
scaling_policy.inference: Without an independently defined sigma_ML, even a qualified absolute inventory fit constrains N_ML*sigma_ML rather than a unique physical monolayer count.
